CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(To_Progress_Notes__c), "",
IF(HOUR(To_Progress_Notes__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(To_Progress_Notes__c)), TEXT(HOUR(To_Progress_Notes__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(To_Progress_Notes__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(To_Progress_Notes__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(To_Progress_Notes__c))) &
IF (HOUR(To_Progress_Notes__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: To Progress Formula
